MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

SECTION 1. SCOPE OF SERVICES
Provider agrees to deliver managed document AI processing and validation.

SECTION 2. PRICING AND PAYMENTS
Ingestion rate is $0.05 per document OCR. Storage rate is $0.20 monthly per GB.
Invoices shall be payable within thirty (30) days of the date of invoice.

SECTION 3. CONFIDENTIALITY
Each party agrees to hold all confidential information in strict confidence.
